corrections.text: The Overview states that the GitHub release page 'shows the tag was created on 2026-10-19'. The release page shows the release's publication time (2026-10-19T11:18:24Z); the tag itself is lightweight and points to a commit dated 2026-10-16. The changelog's October 19, 2026 release date is correct, so the summary's 'tagged October 19' should be read as 'released October 19'.
